title: Hospital exercise record
description: A one-page record of a hospital tabletop exercise in the shape the CMS emergency preparedness rule and Joint Commission exercise standard describe: exercise type, scenario basis, analysis of the response grouped under the six critical areas, revisions to the plan and committee review. It carries a fixed line saying it is an aid and that the hospital's compliance office decides what it satisfies.

scenarioBasis.description: The clinically relevant emergency the scenario narrates and why it was chosen (for example the hazard vulnerability analysis).
examples: A ransomware event removes the EHR for 24 hours; chosen from the top cyber risk in the hazard vulnerability analysis.
CIO, CMIO, CNIO, nursing supervisors, laboratory, pharmacy, HIM, security, privacy

areas.description: Analysis of the response under the six critical areas, in this order: communications; staffing; patient care and clinical support; safety and security; resources and assets; utilities.

action.description: Improvement action, owner and due date.
